Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 40 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Aditya: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aditya searches for his lost ball.]

Aditya: "What happened?"

[Aditya scratches his head.]

Anjali (surprised): "Aditya, look at this."

[Aditya whispers something to Mother.]

Aditya: "Yes, all right."

[Aditya smiles at Mother.]

Aditya (surprised): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Hailstones start falling.]

Aditya: "How beautiful!"

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Aditya: "Show me too!"

[Aditya pats his horse.]

Aditya (gently): "That's easy."

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Aditya stands by the road. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "What a nice place."

[Aditya rides his bicycle down the road.]

Anjali: "Aditya, listen!"

[Aditya gets on the bus.]

Anjali: "I really enjoyed today."
